thread:
dina: Quick sync — customer asks for EU rollout with strict latency SLOs (p95 < 120ms). Thinking staged cohorts by latency sensitivity rather than org size. Thoughts?

sam: Agree on cohorts. Can we map existing customers to latency buckets from recent 30d telemetry?

kai: We have telemetry but needs enrichment: session lengths + prompt length distribution. Current buckets: low (<80ms median), mid (80-150ms), high (>150ms).

priya: For launch criteria, propose: cohort 1 (low latency) -> internal beta + 5 early adopters; criteria: p95 < 100ms, error rate < 0.5%, no model-quality regressions on acceptance prompts.

andre: For cohort 2 (mid), add feature-flag gating + canary ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 48h windows. Must have automatic rollback on latency spike (>20% over baseline).

ops-bot: deploybot: canary started on eu-west-1 at 03:00 UTC. Monitor groups: infra, telemetry.

dina: Good. Question: do we need separate model variants (quantized) behind a flag for cohort2 to meet p95? That would complicate rollouts.

sam: We can use a routing policy: prefer full-precision for cohort1, fall back to quantized for cohort2 when latency budget violated. But model-parity must be evaluated.

kai: That fallback needs TTL for KV cache warmup. If we flip variants, cold KV cache will spike latency. Need warm shadowing for 12h prior.

priya: Customer asks for A/B test vs current hosted model for quality impact. Propose A/B only in cohort1 with 10k sessions sample size, metric: Rouge/embedding-similarity + human eval sample.

andre: Ops: add a hard circuit-breaker route that diverts to degraded tier (lower-rate) if region GPU pressure > 85%. Documented in runbook.

dina: Scope negotiation: customers want rollout in three countries in EU at T0. We should do staggered by country within cohort1: IE/DE/NL sequence, not simultaneous. Helps limit blast radius.

sam: Can we compress steps? IE -> DE (24h) -> NL (24h) seems reasonable. Rollback window 6h after each country ramp if criteria fail.

kai: Telemetry hooks to add: per-country p95, per-tenant error rate, model-quality regression counter tied to eval prompt set. Also flag: disable-variant-fallback per-tenant for sensitive customers.

priya: Who owns communications with customers for cohort2? Sales + CSM. We should prepare runbook summary and an opt-out link per tenant.

andre: I'll draft the runbook snippet for circuit-breaker thresholds and operator actions. Will include CLI kill switch: 
```
redwood rollback-region eu-west-1 --reason \"latency spike\"
```

dina: Nice. Final ask: let's track cost delta when using quantized variant vs baseline so finance gets alerted if >15% cost increase.

sam: Noted. I'll wire an alert.

priya: Next step: finalize cohort membership list, map to country schedule, and freeze flag names. I'll own the checklist.

dina: Thanks — can we reconvene tomorrow 11:00 UTC to sign off? :thumbsup:

andre: +1

sam: 👍

ops-bot: calendarbot: Event created: EU rollout signoff — tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
